_doc.where: Copy to ~/.local/state/pacer/config.json (or $PACER_STATE_DIR/config.json). Every key is optional; the values below are the defaults or examples. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_doc.timeZone: IANA zone for the user's day (night window, asleep noon cap, labels, reportAt). Default: the system zone.
_doc.night: A Session window whose reset falls between resetFrom and resetTo (local, both ends included, may wrap midnight) is a night window.
_doc.dayFinishMin: A day window's pace line reaches 100% this many minutes before the reset.
_doc.nightFinishMin: A night window's pace line reaches 100% this many minutes before the reset.
_doc.priorityWeights: Queue score W per priority: score = W x (1 + days waiting / ageDays) x (paused ? pausedFactor : 1).
_doc.ageDays: Days of waiting that double a queued entry's score.
_doc.pausedFactor: Multiplier for paused (started) work, so it resumes before fresh work of its level.
_doc.nearTie: Within this share of the best score, size breaks the tie (l at night, s by day).
_doc.handoffCompactions: A lead at this many T3 compactions hands off to a fresh thread.
_doc.maxWorking: Working-model threads (workers included) before wakes need pace - tol. The cap never pauses.
_doc.workingModels: Case-insensitive patterns matched against a Claude thread's model id; matches count toward maxWorking.
_doc.reportAt: Local time the morning report goes out (report --morning).
_doc.reportCommand: Shell command that receives the morning report and the wake digest as markdown on stdin (your notifier). Unset: no post.
_doc.sleepFile: Optional JSON file (absolute path) another app writes: {day, bedtime_at, night_until, wake_at, updated_at}, UTC ISO times. The pacer only reads it.
_doc.questions: Optional open-questions hook: {file} (JSON, absolute path) or {command} (prints JSON) mapping thread id to [{id, question, at}]. Remove the key for none.
_doc.triage: Optional triage hook: once per window checkCommand prints a count of new items; N > 0 starts a triage thread in project. {items} = 'N new items', {count} = N.
_doc.emergency: Optional emergency hook: checkCommand prints {causes: [...]}; textCommand gets '<line> --key <key>' as arguments; postCommand gets the line on stdin; chain lists T3 model selections tried in order.
_doc.t3: userdata: T3's data dir. claudeInstance: the T3 provider instance whose usage and threads are paced. mainInstance: where new threads start (default claudeInstance).
_doc.claude: configDir: the Claude config dir behind claudeInstance (for the login notice). providerLogs: read live usage from T3's provider logs (default true; T3's own probe can go stale). The logs don't say which account wrote them, so set false if T3 runs more than one Claude account.
